4.source: relic set 121 (重循苦旅的司铎 / Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal), 4-piece, second half: 「对指定我方单体施放战技或终结技时，使该目标暴击伤害提高#1[i]%，持续#2[i]回合，最多叠加#3[i]层。」 param = [0.18, 2, 2]
4.note: ⚠ Note what this rule does NOT say: 「战技或终结技」 names two cast kinds and the engine splits those at the emitter, so this file carries the SAME rule twice -- here under `ULT_CAST`, and `121` also has a `SKILL_CAST` copy in this file (see its `"on"`). That is two rules for one sentence because the trigger is the point, not duplication to be factored out. ⚠ The buff goes to `target` (「使**该目标**暴击伤害提高」), i.e. the unit this cast was aimed at -- which is why the side test is on the rule and not on the effect. ⚠ `max_stacks: 2` is 「最多叠加2层」: the engine's default would let a second cast REPLACE the first instead of stacking.
